items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: And many of the flute players, including Hubert Laws, well Moody still doubles, I’m thinking Herbie Mann, a lot of those guys just don’t double anymore because it’s a tremendous embouchure change.

ctx.x: I didn’t. But yes, I’ve heard him live many times, and I’m just in awe of what he can do, especially considering that he still doubles to this day. And many of the flute players, including Hubert Laws, well Moody still doubles, I’m thinking Herbie Mann, a lot of those guys just don’t double anymore because it’s a tremendous embouchure change. And it’s been really — the fact that he does it so well, it just amazes me. When I on the other hand tried to play saxophone in college, because everybody told me that I…
